actual_request.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Make ONE complete native high-resolution transparent game walking sprite for star formation girl, SOUTHWEST frame 10/16. Edit reference image 1 into the precise new leg phase described below. Independently DRAW the new joints, knees, cuffs, boots and corresponding robe overlap; no copy, translation, mirrored pose, warped pose or interpolation. One figure only, one single frame, native square canvas at least 1024x1024, preferably same full 1254x1254 canvas as image 1.
INPUTS: Image 1 is current SOUTHWEST pose and exact camera/scale/outfit reference; preserve its upper body, face/crown, silhouette and hand equipment. Image 2 is original character identity only. Image 3 is approved bright polished Daoist chibi hand-painted STYLE reference only; do not copy its UI or other characters.
CAMERA: fixed front-left three-quarter view facing down-left. Both eyes visible, far eye narrower. Keep head and torso angle exactly image 1, no turning frontal or side-on. Large round head, short chibi limbs, no growth in head/body/boots.
PHASE: FAR-RIGHT WEIGHT ACCEPTANCE. After the far-right heel contact, the far anatomical RIGHT boot forward at screen-left settles flat onto the ground, right knee flexes a little under weight. The near anatomical LEFT knee behind at screen-right starts flexing with heel raised and toe leaving ground. The forward far RIGHT white trouser cuff is on the LEFT of the central hanging black-gold front robe panel; the closer LEFT thigh/cuff is to its RIGHT, slightly occluding the farther thigh above the knee. Both boots visible. This is NOT near-leg-forward.
ANATOMY LOCK: character's anatomical LEFT is the NEAR leg on the star-CARD hand side, anatomical RIGHT is the FAR leg on the ASTROLABE hand side. Screen-left boot location alone does not determine leg identity: draw the actual two trouser connections around the center robe flap correctly, as instructed. Cloth moves gently to reveal cuffs; never fuse, hide or duplicate a leg. At least one foot physically grounded. Soft walking only, no running, hopping, squatting or exaggerated kicking.
IDENTITY LOCK: red/gold star crown and small forehead star, high dark half-bun, flowing long dark hair, ruby-brown eyes, black/ivory/red/gold embroidered Daoist robe, star buckle and chains, short black/gold star boots. Right hand holds ONE round astrolabe; left hand holds exactly THREE distinct physical star cards. Match image1 upper-body pose, calm face, hands, proportions, crown height, equipment size and lighting. Only small natural secondary robe/hair/tassel movement.
OUTPUT: complete full body plus all crown/hair/props/boots with safe canvas margin matching image1. Real transparent alpha, no floor or cast shadow, no glow, colored outlines, loose particles, background, grid, lettering or multiple figures. Retain every costume ornament without inventing decorations on the sole. Highest visual polish, clean crisp painted edges.
